criterion: caller whose contract changed not updated
finding: D-25 defers the stale MANIFEST.md obsidian row to 0010-setup-walk, but no contract or wiring IOU names that row.
why: The delta deletes the only reader of AFK_CFG_OBSIDIAN_VAULT; MANIFEST.md:975 still names obsidian notes.sh and an 'unavailable' answer, and 0010 lists MANIFEST.md only as a Scope file, so the deferral has no named owner.
fix: Anchor the deferral in an IOU in .claude/wiring-ious.md naming the row and 0010-setup-walk, or edit the row.
evidence: MANIFEST.md:975 '| `AFK_CFG_OBSIDIAN_VAULT` | `adapters/notes/obsidian/notes.sh` | ... answered `unavailable` rather than crashing |'; DECISIONS.md D-25 'Supersedes: `FRESHNESS.md` same-commit rule ... deferred to 0010-setup-walk'; .claude/wiring-ious.md has no entry

finding: validate FILE on the machine file takes the layer 'repo' instead of 'home' when the repository root is the home folder (a run outside any git checkout).
why: The home entry is added first and the repo entry for root/.afk/config.yaml overwrites it when root is the home folder, so a machine setting there is reported ignored on the file that owns it.
fix: Add the home entry after the repository entries, and pin it with a test that validates the machine file from outside a checkout.
evidence: main(): `root = root if root is not None else path.parent.parent` (1426); `known = {(Path.home() / ".afk" / "config.yaml"): "home"}` then `known[root / ".afk" / "config.yaml"] = "repo"` (547-549)

criterion: Acceptance: Implements the public interface in SDD §8 row "settings reader (changed)" unmodified
finding: The delta adds the public layer_reads, widening the SDD §8 interface the Acceptance bullet says is implemented unmodified.
why: SDD §8 lists four reader answers; layer_reads is a new public name developer_values.py binds to, and D-24 supersedes only the Scope note.
fix: Make it private behind a listed call, or record a decision that supersedes the 'unmodified' bullet.
evidence: SDD.md:497 'merged settings as a plain dictionary (unchanged); ignored values (setting, file, rule); is a repository set up ...; single-file parse'; afk-config.py:477 `def layer_reads(kind: str, committed: bool)`; developer_values.py:172 `ac.layer_reads(kind, committed)`

finding: The jira.site check refuses any address with a path, though the spec types the key as a URL and the adapter keeps a path.
why: A self-hosted Jira under a context path (https://host/jira) is a valid base address, and api.py only strips a trailing slash.
fix: Allow an optional path: re.fullmatch(r"https?://[^/\s]+(/\S*)?", site), and drop the path refusal from the test.
evidence: afk-config.py:827 `re.fullmatch(r"https?://[^/\s]+/?", site)`; SDD §4 '`jira.site` | URL'; test refuses "https://example.net/any/path"; adapters/tracker/jira/api.py:136 `.rstrip("/")`

finding: CONFIG.md still says the no-Python commit check blocks when any Discovery layer mentions repo-hooks, but the shell now reads only the files a team setting is read from.
why: The doc contradicts hooks/precommit-gates.sh:192-195 and CONFIG.md's own rule that no fallback reads an ignored value.
fix: Name the layers the shell reads: AFK_CONFIG and the committed file, else the personal file and the local overlay.
evidence: CONFIG.md:256-257 'or any Discovery layer mentions `repo-hooks` or cannot be read'; precommit-gates.sh:192 '# repo-hooks is a team key: read from the committed file, else the personal file and the local overlay.'

finding: The other-checkout branch of _validate_one finds the true checkout root, but main keeps the guessed root for validate and path_warnings.
why: `kind, root = "shared", common.parent` rebinds only the local root, so relative-path checks for a personal file validated from outside run against the .git folder.
fix: Return the resolved root from _validate_one and use it in main.
evidence: afk-config.py:1426-1433 `root = root if root is not None else path.parent.parent` ... `validate(config, root)` ... `path_warnings(config, root)`; :559 `kind, root = "shared", common.parent`
